questions.q: How does FACTORY differ from CUSTOM in vtxtable?
options: FACTORY works only with digital video systems
FACTORY sends a number, CUSTOM sends MHz
questions.explain: In FACTORY the VTX uses its built-in table; the frequencies in the FC are for display only.

questions.q: A frequency of 0 in a band line means…
options: The lowest frequency of the band
questions.explain: Zero blocks the channel; that is how forbidden frequencies are removed.

questions.q: A neighbor says "I'm on E5". How do you make sure you are not interfering with each other?
options: Trust the letter, everyone's bands are the same
questions.explain: On different VTXs the band letters and numbers can mean different frequencies. Agree in MHz.

questions.q: The order for changing channel when yours is taken?
options: On all aircraft and goggles at once
questions.explain: A mass change without a check is a mass problem.

questions.q: The OSD shows one frequency, the goggles get the picture on another. The cause?
options: The goggles or their receiver module are broken
questions.explain: Load the table made for your VTX model and region.

questions.q: The minimum channel spacing for analog 5.8 GHz to work side by side:
questions.explain: The signal bandwidth is 20–27 MHz; neighboring channels overlap.

questions.q: +15 dB of VTX power gives roughly this much range:
questions.explain: Range ∝ √P: ×1.41 for every 3 dB, 10^(15/20) ≈ 5.6; 25 → 800 mW is ×32 in power, not in range.

questions.q: Why do pilots at a shared field agree on channels in advance?
options: Neighboring analog channels interfere at close frequencies and high power
Otherwise the VTX will not power up
Channels can only be taken in turn
questions.explain: Spacing and low power on the ground reduce mutual interference.
